skills.name: Crackaboom (轰隆隆)
skills.line: Stay at home when the weather isn’t looking good.
skills.description: SP Hiyoribou attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Clearsky Rainbow (澄空彩虹)
skills.line: Windy with clouds and a rainbow. A perfect day for a field trip!
skills.description: Exclusive effect. When other allies deal damage, SP Hiyoribou stores 20% of their damage dealt as Rainbow Energy. Before the start of her turn, and if there is a non-summoned ally with HP below 70%, she consumes Rainbow Energy equal to 120% of her initial ATK to restore their HP, up to 3 allies. ;Rainbow Energy (彩虹能量) :Can store a max of 2400% of her initial ATK.

upgrades.text: Each time she and the non-summoned ally with the highest initial ATK receives damage, consumes Rainbow Energy equal to 60% of her initial ATK to resist an equal amount of damage.
When taking damage, the Rainbow Energy consumed to block it increases to 90% of initial ATK.

skills.name: Sunny Radiance (晴日华光)
skills.line: Fear not. The light will dispel the darkness.
skills.description: SP Hiyoribou grants an ally, other than herself, a Teru Teru Bouzu which lasts for 1 turn and stores Rainbow Energy equal to 600% of her initial ATK, gains 1 Sunshine Doll (3 max before the next turn) ;Teru Teru Bouzu (霹雳娃娃) : :'''General, Status''': When the ally with this inflicts indirect damage, an additional 15% of indirect damage is dealt to the target (cannot exceed 4000% of the ally's initial ATK). ;Sunshine Doll (晴空娃娃) : :'''General, Status''': Max 3 stacks, at the start of each turn (for both sides), removes freeze effects from one non-summoned ally and consumes 1 stack. ;Rainbow Energy (彩虹能量) :Can store a max of 2400% of her initial ATK.

upgrades.text: After an ally with a Teru Teru Bouzu deals or receives damage, restores the HP of 3 non-summoned allies with the lowest HP proportions by 120% of her initial ATK (max of times before the start of her turn).
'''Upper Hand''': Casts Sunny Radiance on the ally with the highest ATK.

bio.condition: With SP Hiyoribou clear any zone 30 times.
